snippet.title: [Poreia] Game Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
A small robot, 'Soma', awakens in a junkyard with all data lost.
Clinging only to faint fragments of memory, it begins a journey to discover who it once was.

'Poreia' is a 3D puzzle adventure game set in a dystopian world.
A demo is scheduled to release this winter on Steam and Stove Indie.

🤖 Follow our official SNS and stay updated on the latest game news!
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ardorbit/
X: https://x.com/ardorbit
